source.passage: GPT‑6 Sol and GPT‑6 Luna are available in ChatGPT Work and Codex starting today for all Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users. Free and Go users can access GPT‑6 Luna in the desktop app. These models are not yet available in Chat.
source.additionalPassage: Prices are per 1 million tokens. GPT‑6 Sol can take on difficult work tasks while giving you more room to iterate with higher usage limits and lower cost.
